overview_description.description: Paperlinks' mission is to hyperlink the real world.  Currently, Paperlinks fulfills this by providing the ultimate QR code infrastructure for businesses.  Paperlinks' solution is end-to-end, providing: a free QR reading app; code generation; a Content Management System for managing code content; and in-house design and print services.
